selection_rule: Two fresh-account training years, stress costs. Each year retains at least min(0, baseline return), has >=3 completed trades and no worse DD. Retain >=70% of summed positive baseline profit; worst training DD <=85% baseline. Select lowest worst DD, then highest summed return. Freeze selection before final year. Reject selected coin on either cost case if final-year DD increases or return retains <80% of positive baseline / worsens negative baseline.

Vorhandene USDC-Kerzen werden verwendet; historische USDT-Kerzen ergänzen ausschließlich fehlende ältere Historie, sofern native_usdc_candle_count dokumentiert ist.
